newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt cuts discount rate to 13.25 from 13.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Egypt cuts discount rate to 13.25 from 13.5 pct.

text.p: The Central Bank of Egypt said it was cutting its discount rate with effect from Thursday to 13.25 percent from 13.5 percent.
It was the first cut in the rate since November 23, 1995, when it fell half a percentage point.
Bankers say they never borrow at the discount rate, which is merely indicative of the Central Bank's intentions about interest rates in general.
The reduction is in line with a gradual decline in treasury bill rates, which since November 1995 have fallen to an average of 10.178 percent from about 10.5 percent on 91-day bills.
